resources.title: Resources
resources.missing: File or folder not found: the resource stays in the list.
resources.openFailed: The resource could not be opened.
resources.openRefused: This kind of file is not opened from the app.
resources.preview: Load the preview · contacts the site
resources.previewFailed: The page could not be read (unreachable, not a web page or too large). The resource stays.
resources.removeHint: Only the entry leaves the list: the page, file or folder is not touched.
resources.empty: Code, data, web pages, notebooks and folders that go with the research: add them with “Resource or link…”.

add.title: Add a resource or link
add.urlHint: A link to a repository, a dataset, a page or an online notebook.
add.chooseTitle: Choose a file in the library
add.chooseFolderTitle: Choose a folder in the library
add.name: Title (optional)
add.previewNote: The preview is optional and only on request: reading the title of a page contacts the site.
add.linkedTo: It will be linked to this document.
add.need: Type an address or choose a file or a folder.

reason.not-http: Only http and https addresses are accepted.
reason.credentials: The address must not contain a user name or a password.
reason.private-host: The address points to this computer or to a private network.
reason.outside: The resource must be inside the library.
reason.kind: The chosen path is not of the stated type.
reason.missing: The chosen path no longer exists.
reason.not-approved: Choose the path with the selection window.
reason.empty: Type an address or choose a file or a folder.

importId.title: From DOI, arXiv or URL
importId.field: Identifiers or addresses, one per line
importId.hint: A DOI (10.1000/xyz), an arXiv identifier (2401.01234) or an address that contains one. The data come from OpenAlex and arXiv; nothing about you is sent.
importId.offlineHint: OpenAlex or arXiv could not be reached. Check the connection and retry.

reason.not-http: Only http and https addresses are accepted.
reason.private-host: The address points to this computer or to a private network.
reason.credentials: The address must not contain a user name or a password.
reason.no-id: It contains neither a DOI nor an arXiv identifier.
reason.shape: The identifier is not in a valid form.
reason.error: The answer of the service could not be read.

importId.downloadHint: arXiv only: it contacts export.arxiv.org. The file goes to Arrivals, where you confirm the name and folder before it is copied into the library.
importId.resultFailed: {{count}} PDFs not downloaded: the entry was added without a file.
importId.noFileNote: Without the PDF an entry is added as “No file”, among the resources.
